column2: # 必须带 earlycon=sbi：Alpine 内核编了 SBI earlycon 驱动，有它约 150M 指令内\n  # 就能看到输出；没有它内核会把 printk 攒在 ring buffer 里，直到 16550 控制台\n  # 注册（约 350-400M 指令）才一次性倒出 —— 看起来像卡死。
column3:
# Always pass earlycon=sbi: the Alpine kernel has the SBI earlycon driver, and with
  # it you see output within about 150M instructions. Without it the kernel buffers
  # printk until the 16550 console registers (350-400M instructions) and then dumps
  # everything at once, which looks exactly like a hang.

column2:
# 用的是未压缩的 initramfs.cpio：内核认不出压缩就直接按裸 cpio 用，
  # 省掉在模拟器里跑 inflate。同机同核实测（两条路都到 shell）：
  #   initramfs.cpio.gz   1,270,638,213 条指令   到 /init 用 t=120.26s
  #   initramfs.cpio        776,011,912 条指令   到 /init 用 t=64.67s
  # 省 4.95 亿条（38.9%）。差别不是能不能起来，是快多少。
  # （虚拟秒与指令数不成正比：内核的 time 走被抖动的 mtime，指令数才是准的。）
column3:
# This run booted the uncompressed initramfs.cpio: the kernel does not recognise a
compression format and uses the archive as a plain cpio, skipping the inflate pass.
Measured on one machine with one kernel (both reach a shell):
  initramfs.cpio.gz   1,270,638,213 instructions, /init at t=120.26s
  initramfs.cpio        776,011,912 instructions, /init at t=64.67s
That is 495M instructions, 38.9%. The difference is speed, not whether it boots.
(Virtual seconds are not proportional to instructions: the kernel's time comes from a
jittered mtime. Trust instret.)

column2: # 这次用的是压缩态 initramfs.cpio.gz。想快 38.9% 就补一步（实测省 4.95 亿条指令）：\n  #     npx tsx tools/initramfs.ts decompress {0}/initramfs.cpio.gz {0}/initramfs.cpio\n  # 然后把下面 --initrd 换成 {0}/initramfs.cpio。
column3:
# This run kept the compressed initramfs.cpio.gz. One extra step makes it 38.9%
  # faster (measured: 495M instructions saved):
